supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Moderate extension of the ridge beyond the eye corner visible in profile

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between light, mottled muzzle/chin area and dark periocular/cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thin vertical profile with minimal structural droop

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Vivid red/pink tissue exposure or lesion visible at the superior base of the pinna
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, irregular light-colored dappling/spotting on the skin of the lower muzzle and chin
